video_policy: Default GUI/CLI: FFmpeg source MP4/AVI/MKV/MOV to playable NVL1 PCM; NVA1 NAR2 optional; explicit skip available. Game/device/video compatibility is not universal.
audio_policy: lossless NAR2 voice with NAR1/PCM compatibility; default BGM and SE remain PCM; cautious 1.5 dB post-mix loudness target with 64-sample peak limiter for BGM/SE/voice/video; game volume settings unchanged
cache_layout: two-hex prefix directories in format 6; formats 1-5 remain flat
ui_additions: Three display modes: upper game, lower game, enhanced top scene + lower story dialogue; preserve authored upper title before first say; original clock and 48px icon; UP/DOWN and single-row START/SELECT auxiliary help; four locale glyph coverage; 16 NDS IPL theme colors with cached Auto preference and four-language centered settings; unified 2px rail with approved final typography; title-stage help reset after restart; START launches from game library; rounded title highlight blend.
